title: The Ignorant Physician
logline: An old physician is honest enough to refuse a job his failing eyes cannot do; a confident fraud takes it, poisons the prince by ignorance, and is made to drink his own mixture.
moral: False confidence kills. Knowing the limit of what you can do is part of knowledge.
tone: A dark cautionary tale told with restraint. Light comedy only in the first two thirds and only at the fraud's expense (the mask dropping, the sneeze); from the moment the prince drinks, the film goes quiet: stillness, eyes, a lamp going out. Both deaths are shown indirectly.

beats.summary: A famous, trusted physician in a distant city.
Years pass; his sight fails until he cannot tell his own medicines apart. He knows it, and stops his hand.
The king's son falls gravely ill.
The old physician diagnoses the illness and names the right medicine (the three-jar recipe).
He refuses to mix it himself because he cannot see well: honest about his limit.
An ignorant man overhears and sees a chance for money and royal favour.
At the palace he declares with full confidence: I am a physician.
Alone in the medicine store, the mask drops: he knows none of the jars.
His wandering hand lands on the poison jar; the audience knows, he does not.
The king takes the man's speed for skill.
The prince dies; the lamp by his bed goes out.
The furious king asks: are you sure? The man has no answer.
The king orders him to drink his own medicine.
The man drinks, is poisoned and dies too.
The old physician lives, but cannot bring the prince back.
False confidence has cost two lives.

sets.description: Planned set marketStreet, palette 'clear' (day): skyline, house fronts, palace facade with a tall arched door at x 760..900 (door top y 520) on the right. Ground y 900.

Planned set bedchamber (KD-010) dressed as the prince's room, day and dim states. Floor y 900. Door x 40..190, top y 560 (opens inward). Window x 420..580, y 300..470. Bed across the right: frame x 520..940, mattress top y 770, headboard x 900..940 rising to y 640, pillow x 800..890; people standing behind the bed are visible from the waist up. Back wall navy with blue Ben-Day dots; three shelf boards (16 thick, brown) at y 330, 500 and 670 from x 120 to x 880; 7 jars per shelf at x 160, 270, 380, 490, 600, 710, 820. Worktable x 300..700, top y 760, legs to the floor y 900. Door x 40..170, top y 560, on the left. Four hanging herb bunches from the ceiling at x 200, 400, 620, 800 (y 120..230).

props.description: medicineJar: 70 wide x 100 tall rounded jar with a flat lid and a label 44 x 36 carrying 2 or 3 squiggle lines (never readable text). Colours cycle yellow, blue, white, green, brown. Recipe jars: yellow with a leaf mark, blue with a drop mark, white with a dot mark. Poison jar: red body, black lid, black X on the label, on the middle shelf at x 710 (6th slot). Fields: lidOff, tilt, glow, puff.
Mortar 120 wide x 70 tall (white, blue dots) with a pestle 90 long; mixture colour and level fields; sits at (500, 760) on the worktable.
Planned smallBowl enlarged to 60 wide: yellow bowl, fill colour murky purple with red dots, level 1 then 0.5 after the prince drinks; can be held in a hand, handed over and dropped.

recipeStrip: a white speech/label box holding three 40 px jar icons (yellow leaf, blue drop, white dot) and a small mortar icon. First appears as the old physician's speech balloon (S2); returns small at the top left of the panel in S6 with a green tick or red cross popping on each ingredient as the man chooses.
Planned stick (180 x 12 staff from grip point and angle) for the old physician.
Planned oilLamp on the wall shelf at (700, 560): brass lamp, flame 26 high with flicker; field flame 0..1 and a smoke wisp when it goes out.
The man's red turban as a separate drawable (60 wide) that can fall, roll with rotation and settle with a damped wobble.
Planned coinPile (mound of n coins) and a small crown icon, shown inside the thought cloud.

scenes.summary: The distant city and its famous physician at his stall: precise, trusted. Years spin past; his beard whitens and his sight fails. He reaches for a jar, nearly takes the wrong one, and stops himself.

scenes.composition: Stall centre-left, the physician behind the table facing right (dir 1) at x 400, head near panel centre height. Patients queue on the right (x 560 and 680), so the eye line runs left to right. Palace door far right at the wide shot only, planting it for S4. Keep the sky area above the awning free for the label and counters.

subtitles.ar: كان في مدينة بعيدة طبيب مشهور بعلمه وخبرته.|عالج مرضى كثيرين، وكان الناس يثقون به.|لكن مع مرور السنين ضعف بصره|حتى لم يعد يستطيع رؤية الأدوية التي يستعملها.
subtitles.en: In a distant city lived a physician known for his knowledge and experience.|He had treated many patients, and people trusted him.|But over the years his sight weakened|until he could no longer see the medicines he used.

subtitles.ar: وفي يوم، مرض ابن الملك مرضًا شديدًا.|أحضروا الطبيب العجوز، فسأل الشاب عن ألمه وأعراضه.|فكر قليلًا، ثم عرف المرض وشرح الدواء الذي يحتاج إليه،|لكنه رفض أن يخلطه بيده لأنه لا يرى جيدًا.
subtitles.en: One day the king’s son fell gravely ill.|They brought the old physician, who asked the young man about his pain and symptoms.|After thinking, he recognized the illness and described the needed medicine,|but refused to mix it himself because he could not see well.

subtitles.ar: سمع رجل جاهل بالقصة،|ورأى فيها فرصة ليكسب المال ويقترب من الملك.|ذهب إلى القصر وقال بثقة:|«أنا طبيب، وأعرف كيف أخلط الأدوية. دعوني أجهز علاج الأمير.»
subtitles.en: An ignorant man heard the story|and saw a chance to earn money and gain the king’s favor.|He went to the palace and said confidently,|“I am a physician, and I know how to mix medicines. Let me prepare the prince’s treatment.”

subtitles.ar: صدقه رجال القصر، وأدخلوه مخزن الأدوية.|كانت الرفوف مليئة بعلب الأعشاب والمساحيق.|نظر الرجل حوله، لكنه لم يعرف أسماء أكثرها|ولا أثرها في الجسم.
subtitles.en: The palace officials believed him and led him into the medicine store.|The shelves were full of boxes of herbs and powders.|He looked around but did not know the names of most of them|or their effects on the body.

subtitles.ar: بدأ يأخذ قليلًا من هذه العلبة وقليلًا من تلك.|وبين الأشياء التي اختارها مسحوق سام لا يصلح للشرب.|لم يدرك خطره، فخلطه مع بقية المواد|وقدمه في إناء صغير.
subtitles.en: He began taking a little from one box and a little from another.|Among the things he chose was a poisonous powder that could not be swallowed.|He did not recognize the danger, mixed it with the other substances,|and brought it in a small bowl.

subtitles.ar: أعجب الملك بسرعة الرجل، وظن أنها دليل على مهارته.|أمر أن يشرب ابنه الدواء.|لكن الأمير اشتد عليه الألم بعد أن شربه، ومات بعد وقت قصير.|عم الحزن القصر كله.
subtitles.en: The king was impressed by the man’s speed and took it as a sign of skill.|He ordered his son to drink the medicine.|But the prince’s pain worsened after drinking it, and he died soon afterward.|Grief filled the palace.

subtitles.ar: غضب الملك وسأل الرجل:|«هل أنت متأكد أن هذا هو العلاج|الصحيح؟» لم يجد الجاهل جوابًا|مقنعًا. عندها أمره الملك أن يشرب من الدواء نفسه الذي صنعه للأمير.
subtitles.en: The king was furious and asked the man,|“Are you certain that this was the correct treatment?”|The ignorant man had no convincing answer.|The king then ordered him to drink the very medicine he had prepared for the prince.

subtitles.ar: شرب الرجل من الخليط، فأصابه السم ومات هو أيضًا.|بقي الطبيب العجوز حيًا، لكنه لم يستطع إعادة الأمير.|وكان الجميع يعرف الآن|أن الثقة الكاذبة قد قتلت شخصين.
subtitles.en: The man drank the mixture, was poisoned, and died too.|The old physician remained alive, but he could not bring the prince back.|Everyone now knew|that false confidence had cost two people their lives.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (physician, king, prince, quack)
new_assets.description: Four more presets for the planned person costume layer (same body, face, arm IK and gestures). physician: small white turban, long beard, blue dotted robe, yellow sash, with age 0..1 (beard black to white, stoop 0 to 0.12, permanent squint). king: gold three-point crown, full black beard, red robe with yellow trim, 8 % wider. prince: thin gold circlet, no facial hair, white dotted nightshirt, pale ill skin tone option. quack: oversized red turban drawn as a detachable piece, thin curled moustache, yellow robe with red dots, pointed slippers. The two officials use the planned 'vizier' preset in two palettes; the townspeople use the planned 'villager'.
new_assets.implementation: One costume(P) hook called by person after the body: headwear from K rounded rects and arcs (turban = 3 stacked ellipses with a wrap line; crown = polygon with 3 points and 3 small circles), beard as a filled bezier under the mouth whose fill lerps black to white with age, robe as the existing torso recoloured with halftone dots. Detachable turban: skip it in costume when P.hat === false and draw the quackTurban prop instead.

new_assets.name: apothecary
new_assets.description: Medicine store interior: navy dotted wall, three shelves (y 330, 500, 670; x 120..880) with 7 jars each, worktable x 300..700 with top at y 760, door on the left with open and closed states, four hanging herb bunches. Reusable for any physician, alchemist, perfumer or spice-merchant story (it is the planned 'storeroom' idea with shelves of jars).
new_assets.implementation: bake() the wall, boards and table once; jars are drawn live from a 21-entry table {x, shelf, colour, mark} through medicineJar so single jars can glow, hop, lose a lid or leave the shelf. Herb bunches: 5 green bezier leaves on a stalk, swing() for sway. Door: rectangle with an arc top, open = a parallelogram plus a lighter doorway.

new_assets.name: medicineKit (medicineJar, mortar, recipeStrip)
new_assets.description: medicineJar 70 x 100 with lid, squiggle label and optional mark (leaf, drop, dot, X), fields colour, lidOff, tilt, glow, puff. Mortar 120 x 70 with pestle 90 long and a mixture colour and level. recipeStrip: a white box with three 40 px jar icons and a mortar icon, each with an optional green tick or red cross.
new_assets.implementation: Jar: K rounded rect body with halftone shading on the right third, flat lid rect, label rect with 2-3 seeded squiggle strokes (K.rng) so no text is readable. Mortar: half ellipse bowl on a short foot; pestle a tapered capsule that follows the hand target. recipeStrip reuses medicineJar at s 0.4 inside S.box; ticks and crosses are two-stroke brush marks with settleTo pop.

new_assets.name: stick, coinPile, smallBowl
new_assets.description: Reuse of the planned small props: the old physician's walking stick, the coin pile in the thought cloud, and the small bowl (drawn here 60 wide with fill colour and level) that carries the medicine.
new_assets.implementation: As planned in KD-015 and AN-095. Bowl: half ellipse with a rim line, the liquid an inner ellipse whose colour and height are fields; when held it follows the midpoint of handL and handR.

new_assets.name: oilLamp
new_assets.description: Planned brass hand lamp on a wall shelf with a flame field 0..1 and a smoke wisp, used to say the prince's death without showing more.
new_assets.implementation: As planned in KD-010; add flame scale and, when flame is 0, three thin bezier smoke strokes that rise 60 px and fade over 1.5 s (a function of time since out).

new_assets.name: blurVision
new_assets.description: Weak-sight point of view: whatever is drawn inside is shown doubled and drifting with a pale halftone veil, strength 0..1. Used three times (stall shelf, tray, bowl) so the audience learns it once and recognises it later.
new_assets.implementation: blurVision(ctx, draw, k, t): call draw twice with offsets +/- 14k px (x) and +/- 5k px (y) that breathe with sin(t * 1.3), each at alpha 0.55, then a white dot veil at alpha 0.25k and a soft round vignette built from the style's halftone dots. No canvas filter, so frames stay deterministic.

new_assets.description: Planned rich bedroom, used as the prince's sickroom with the dimensions given in sets, a wall shelf for the lamp, a stool and a foreground carpet chest.
new_assets.implementation: As planned in KD-010; the chest is a separate foreground draw call (rounded rect 230 x 100 with a diamond carpet pattern) placed after the cast.

owner_questions: The prince's death is shown softly (eyes close, a hand slides to the blanket, the bedside lamp goes out) with no X eyes; default: keep it this soft.
The ignorant man's death happens out of sight (he sinks behind a carpet chest and only his red turban rolls out); default: keep it off screen.

The old physician stays in the sickroom during paragraphs 6 to 8 and at 113.5 tries and fails to see the bowl, which the script does not say; default: keep, because it makes his survival in paragraph 8 readable.
A recipe strip (three jar icons with ticks and crosses) and a POISON! label tell the audience more than the man knows; default: keep both.
Added comic lettering and gags not in the script: AHA!, ? ? ?, ACHOO! (a sneeze), SO FAST!, UH..., plus ARE YOU SURE? and THE SAME MEDICINE which echo the narration; default: keep all.
Paragraph 1 adds two townspeople being cured and a CURED counter to show 'treated many patients'; the same two are the gossips in paragraph 3; default: keep.
The final moral is lettered as FALSE CONFIDENCE with a counter reaching 2; default: keep (alternative: no lettering, picture only).
implementation_notes: World 1000 x 1230, floor or ground y 900 in all three sets. People are drawn at s 1.35 (about 324 tall); the king s 1.4. Keep faces above panel y 1000.
Cue every action from timing.json words, not from the literal times here; the times in this plan are the word starts listed in planning/inputs/timeline.md.

Set LIFE.t = t each frame for automatic blinks; add hand blinks to characters with an explicit lid (old physician lid >= 0.45, ill prince lid 0.6). Use noBlink for the king at 152.2-155.6 and for everyone during the 117.7-118.2 hold.

Mask on / mask off for the man: confident pose = sq 1.08, tip -0.06, lid 0.4, mouth 'smile' or smirk; unmasked = sq 0.94-0.96, brow -0.7, saccades with gazePlan(t, plan, 0.07). Switch only when nobody is looking at him (78.4) or when he is cornered (135.3 on).
The old physician always works nose-close and with a squint; the same blurVision effect is used at 15.4, 42.4 and 113.5 with identical styling.

The half-full bowl is one object from 103.8 to 155.0: level 1 until the prince drinks (0.5), held by official1 from 117.7 to 145.2, emptied by the man at 152.2. Keep its fill colour (murky purple with red specks) identical throughout.
The poison jar is at the same place (middle shelf, x 710) in every store shot from 71.4 on, so a second viewing shows it waiting.

S9: draw order is room, king and officials, the man, then the foreground carpet chest; he disappears by passing behind it, no clipping. Nothing is drawn of him afterwards; the turban prop takes over at 156.6.
Sound: effects only at the listed pause times; all quiet (master 0.6). The thud at 125.9 is the king's knees, very soft; no effect at all on the prince's death itself or on the man's fall.
Panel-only shake at 86.6 (sneeze, 4 px) and 132.5 (the king's foot, 6 px); the caption panel never moves.
Lettering total is 15 items including counters and THE END; none may cover a face. Speech-like lettering (ARE YOU SURE?) sits above and between the heads.
Transition: one 'later' card (ONE DAY...) at 20.8-22.3 with the set change under its midpoint; the S6 to S7 change is a 4-frame whip, the rest are cuts.
After approval move the costume presets, apothecary, medicineKit and blurVision into Library/ with registry.js entries, run node Library/tests/regression.mjs and rebuild the catalogue.
warnings: Depends on several planned assets that are not in Library/ yet (person costume layer, lie and kneel/sit poses, marketStreet, bedchamber, thoughtCloud, dayCycle, painPulse, flush, oilLamp). If this story is animated before the stories that planned them, they must be built here first: the effort is larger than the four assets that are new to this plan suggest.
Six people share the sickroom in S7 and S8; at 9:16 the wide shots get crowded. Keep the officials near the door, use the two-shots given, and check a contact sheet for overlapping heads.
The story contains two deaths including a child-aged prince; the staging is deliberately indirect, but the owner should confirm the level (see owner_questions).
The word 'هو' at 156.74 has an interpolated time; the turban cue uses the same time as 'أيضًا' and is safe either way.
Arms are short (about 74 units at s 1): handing the bowl between people needs them within about 150 px of each other at s 1.35; stage the hand-overs accordingly.
